title: Mara and the Ledger
author: Mara Montrose
blurb: Dominic Quintana, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
